---

## 1. Get a VirusTotal API Key (if you don’t already have one)

You mentioned you already have a key (`db_key456`), so you’re good to go. If you ever need a new key, you can request one from the VirusTotal website under your account settings.

---

## 2. Understand the API Endpoint

For domain queries, VirusTotal offers the following endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}
```

Replace `{domain}` with the domain you’re interested in (e.g., `dropbox.com`).

---

## 3. Make the Request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client in your preferred programming language. Below are examples for `curl` and Python.

### Using `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/dropbox.com" \
     -H "x-apikey: db_key456"
```

### Using Python (`requests` library)

```python
import requests

api_key = "db_key456"
domain = "dropbox.com"
url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
data = response.json()

print(data)
```
